source: IMPORT ids FROM 'types.transit'; CREATE MODULE Rows(name IDENTIFIER, element TYPE) AS BEGIN CREATE PUBLIC TABLE $name (id $element PRIMARY KEY); EXPORT TABLE $name AS rows; END; CREATE MODULE Forward(name IDENTIFIER) AS BEGIN USE Rows(name, TYPE ids.MachineId) AS inner; EXPORT TABLE inner.rows AS forwarded; END; CREATE MODULE Put(rows TABLE(id ids.MachineId PRIMARY KEY), value ids.Target) AS BEGIN MATCH value WHEN ids.Target.Machine(id) THEN INSERT INTO $rows VALUES ($id); WHEN ids.Target.Site(other) THEN SELECT * FROM $rows; END MATCH; END; CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN USE Forward(NAME 'machines') AS app; USE Put(app.forwarded, ids.Target.Machine(ids.MachineId(7))); END;

name: queue-program-build
source: CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN CREATE PUBLIC QUEUE requests (id BIGINT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE PUBLIC TABLE accepted (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE PUBLIC STREAM events (id BIGINT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE PUBLIC DATAFLOW process FROM QUEUE requests AS request AS BEGIN LET body = request.body || '!'; REQUIRE request.id > 0 ELSE 'InvalidId'; BEGIN ATOMIC IF request.body <> '' THEN INSERT INTO accepted VALUES (request.id, body) ON CONFLICT (id) DO ASSERT SAME ROW; PRODUCE INTO events VALUES (request.id, body); ELSE REQUIRE FALSE ELSE 'Empty'; END IF; END; END; AUTHORIZE DATAFLOW process AS ROLE CURRENT_ROLE; ACTIVATE DATAFLOW process; END;
